question_text: Reduce the equation x+2y−3z−6=0 of the plane to the normal form.

mark_split.label: Divide by the root of the squares

recall_prompt: Say how you would solve this — say what you divide by, and what the coefficients become afterwards.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Move the constant across
steps.margin_note: First mark. Normal form is lx + my + nz = p, so the constant goes to the right and the coefficients are left alone for the moment.
steps.memory_tip: Normal form is lx + my + nz = p, so move the constant right and leave the coefficients alone for now.
lines: Equation of the plane is  x + 2y − 3z − 6 = 0

recall.must_convey: That the constant is moved across to give x + 2y − 3z = 6.
accept: move the constant to the right hand side
normal form is l x plus m y plus n z equals p
get the constant alone on the right
constant ni right side ki teesukovali

steps.why: Normal form differs from intercept form in what it divides by — the ROOT of the sum of the squared coefficients, not the constant — so the constant is left on the right rather than divided out.
common_mistakes: Dividing by the constant, which gives intercept form instead.

steps.label: Divide by the root of the squares
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Divide every term by √(a²+b²+c²). The three coefficients then square-and-add to 1, which is what makes them direction cosines of the normal.
steps.memory_tip: Divide EVERY term by √(a²+b²+c²). The three coefficients then square-and-add to 1.
lines: Dividing the above equation by √(1² + 2² + (−3)²) = √(1 + 4 + 9) = √14, we have

lines.text: (1/√14)x + (2/√14)y + (−3/√14)z = 6/√14,  which is in the normal form

accept: divide every term by the root of one plus four plus nine which is root fourteen
the coefficients then square and add to one
divide by the root of the sum of the squares

steps.why: After dividing, the coefficients ARE the direction cosines of the normal to the plane, and the right-hand side is the perpendicular distance from the origin.
common_mistakes: Dividing by 1+4+9 = 14 instead of its square root.
Forgetting to divide the right-hand side.
